output.question: Who is the parent company of Saks?
output.answer: Saks Fifth Avenue (and Saks Off 5th) is now owned by Exemplar Luxury Group, the new name of the company formerly called Saks Global. It took that name when it exited Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The reorganization plan was confirmed on June 5, 2026 and took effect on June 26, 2026. The lenders who funded the bankruptcy, led by Pentwater Capital Management and Bracebridge Capital, became the controlling shareholders, and Geoffroy van Raemdonck is still CEO. Exemplar also owns Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman.

key_facts.fact: Saks Global's bankruptcy plan was approved June 5, 2026 and took effect June 26, 2026, and the company rebranded as Exemplar Luxury Group
The lenders who provided the bankruptcy financing became the controlling shareholders, and Pentwater Capital Management and Bracebridge Capital each hold two board seats
Geoffroy van Raemdonck continues as CEO
Exemplar Luxury Group LLC (formerly Saks Global) is a New York-based holding company whose subsidiaries are Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks Off 5th

passages.quote: the plan took effect on June 26
Geoffroy van Raemdonck continues as Chief Executive Officer

caveats: Some people still call the parent 'Saks Global', which was its name before June 2026. Older sources (2024–2025) describe Saks Global as the parent, formed when it bought Neiman Marcus.
No source I opened gave each lender's exact equity stake after the bankruptcy exit. Amazon's roughly 23% stake from before the bankruptcy was described as presumptively worthless.
No primary source was opened, such as the company's press release or the court filing. The facts come from Retail TouchPoints and Wikipedia.
Saks Off 5th has been cut back to a few stores used mainly to clear excess inventory.
